FROZEN_OUTPUT_FOR_THE_CURRENT_DESIGN.STOP_RULE: stop on PAIRS, not on cost. The ceiling is a cost bound, not a stopping rule. A ceiling that binds must be news, not a result. Pre-register an interim re-estimate that may only RAISE the ceiling, never lower the target.

THE_INSTRUMENT_REFUSES_512.why: a ceiling of 512 is below the median cost 629.0 of accruing 41 pairs. More than half of all campaigns under this design end on the ceiling with the target unmet. That is not a risk, it is the expected outcome.

SELF_TESTS.test: the 95% ceiling for 41 pairs is between 700 and 900
OMLDCT02's frozen ceiling of 512 is below the median cost of its own target
a ceiling of 512 for 41 pairs is REFUSED by the instrument
a ceiling of 800 for 41 pairs is not refused
the TLMR01 developmental rate is more than 1.8x the realised rate
sizing from TLMR01 is flagged DO_NOT_SIZE_FROM_THIS

NOT_EXCHANGEABLE_WITH_THE_PROSPECTIVE_LE.WHY_IT_CANNOT_BE_DIAGNOSED: the 256 developmental archives no longer exist in this container, so the most likely explanation — that 'carried' meant something laxer before the E3 qualification rule was rebuilt during OMLDCT01 — cannot be checked. What survives is the conclusion: do not size from that set.

OMLDCT02.rule: 41 valid paired blocks under a 512 arm-instance ceiling

TWO_CAMPAIGNS_FROZEN_WITH_SINGLE_DIGIT_P.COMMON_CAUSE: a target and a cost ceiling frozen independently and never checked against each other. This instrument exists so that check is not optional.

THE_OWNERS_RULE_IS_UNTOUCHED: fewer than 41 pairs may not be interpreted using the paired p-values. Nothing here does.
